violation_type.title: Swimming - Lifeguard Counted in Ratio when only Center Children Present (26 TAC §746.2111(b))
violation_type.short_title: Swimming - Lifeguard Counted in Ratio when only Center Children Present
violation_type.typical_finding: There was a certified life guard watching five children during swim time in the pool but was not a qualified caregiver.
